style: Night set in Maya's room: moon and stars in the window, warm desk-lamp glow, DUO.mug() on the desk's right end. Maya sits behind the desk with Floey perched on the laptop lid facing her (floeyLaptop, facing -1). The red '12 clicks' pill stays near Maya's head (x 880, y 610) all reel as the problem that does not go away. Amber MAYA and pink FLOEY captions. Running joke: Maya typing her way out of every problem.

panels.subject: maya shot (not mayaTight, so both pills stay in frame). Maya behind the desk under the lamp glow, desk mug visible. Red DUO.stat '12 clicks' and neutral DUO.stat 'Post 31' already up beside her head.
panels.action: From the very first frame Maya is typing hard, pose type, expr panic, eyes down at the laptop (look 0, 1) as she starts her line mid-panic.

panels.subject: maya shot. Maya and both pills, with the red '12 clicks' pill in focus.
panels.action: On 'twelve' the red pill pulses big and settles. Maya's head snaps up off the keys for a beat while her hands keep typing. The small shake is her real panic.

panels.subject: floeyTight: Floey alone on the laptop lid, Maya out of frame.
panels.action: Hard cut on 'Stop typing.' Floey pivots toward Maya and tilts her head, mood think, deadpan.

panels.subject: floeyTight: Floey on the lid.
panels.action: On 'already wrote the answer' she gives one slow deadpan blink, then holds her tilt.

panels.subject: wide two-shot: Maya behind the desk, Floey on the lid, both pills still beside Maya's head.
panels.action: Maya jolts, swings to pose pointL at Floey on the laptop, expr panic, faster and higher.

panels.subject: wide two-shot.
panels.action: On 'traffic' Floey slowly tilts her head the other way, unbothered, while Maya's finger is still jabbing at her.

panels.subject: wide two-shot, with a slow drift toward Floey's side that keeps both pills inside the frame.
panels.action: Floey pivots square to Maya, deadpan, and starts the tip. Maya holds her point for a moment, expr annoyed.

panels.subject: wide two-shot: Maya and the pills.
panels.action: Maya drops from point to pose type with a huff, expr annoyed, eyes back on the laptop.

panels.subject: wide two-shot: the neutral 'Post 31' pill beside the red one.
panels.action: On 'crawled' the 'Post 31' pill pops out of existence as Maya gives up on it. The red '12 clicks' pill stays.

panels.subject: wide two-shot.
panels.action: On 'turn on' Floey gives one small nod. Maya follows the steps on the keys, clicking through Search Console to Queries, still annoyed.

panels.subject: wide two-shot.
panels.action: Maya says 'Fine.' flat, expr annoyed, and types one hard stroke.

panels.subject: Laptop screen cutaway: DUO.listInsert titled 'Search Console · Queries', sub 'Average position on · sorted by position', columns Query / Impressions / Position. These are Maya's example numbers, not real data.
panels.action: The insert swings in. Rows slide in already sorted with rowsK: 'best budget rail pass europe 310 4.2', 'interrail packing list 180 7.9', 'cheap night trains italy 2,300 11.4', 'lisbon on a budget 90 18.6', 'hostel or hotel paris 60 23.1', 'slow travel tips 40 31.5'.

panels.subject: Laptop screen cutaway held: the same Search Console Queries list.
panels.action: On 'Cheap night trains Italy' the 'cheap night trains italy 2,300 11.4' row gets the hi ring, which grows as hiK rises. A slight push-in toward the row for the realisation.

panels.subject: wide two-shot: Maya, Floey on the lid, red '12 clicks' pill.
panels.action: Cut back on 'My old post's at eleven!' Maya jolts, expr surprised, and a DUO.mark '!' pops over her bun.

panels.subject: wide two-shot.
panels.action: On the lid Floey preens once, smug, mood happy. Maya's '!' fades out.

panels.subject: wide two-shot, red '12 clicks' pill still up.
panels.action: Floey tilts toward Maya, warm, mood happy. Maya listens, expr think, and nods slowly on 'answer it better'.

panels.subject: wide two-shot.
panels.action: On 'Give it a few weeks' Maya goes back to pose type, calm now (expr neutral), with soft steady keystrokes. The red pill stays: there is no instant win.

panels.subject: wide two-shot.
panels.action: Floey pivots front to face the camera, deadpan and smug, for her button line. Under it, Maya switches to pose mug. The desk DUO.mug() stops drawing on that frame, so there is only one mug.

panels.subject: wide two-shot.
panels.action: Maya sips, then grimaces at the cold coffee, expr annoyed, without a word.

panels.subject: mayaTight: Maya's face fills the frame, still holding the mug. The red pill fades out just before the push so it is not sliced.
panels.action: After the line Maya slowly turns and gives the camera a long flat look over her glasses. It holds about 1.3 seconds.

panels.subject: End card: the Flowra logo intact with 'Maya & Floey, every day', and Floey perched on the spark's left arm, facing the camera.
panels.action: The end card lands with a thump, and Floey settles onto the spark's left arm.
